verdict.rationale: Jev is a hosted API service, so data region or residency selection is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions choosing a storage region or data residency. The only related material is a no-training statement plus a DPA and zero-data-retention option for enterprise customers. Those are adjacent privacy controls, not region selection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
